facts.business: Hind Aluminium Industries Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of aluminium products, including the recently acquired Elessar Focchi business division of Nirav Commercials Limited.
key_risks: Defined benefit obligation valuation sensitivity to actuarial assumptions
Related party transactions pricing and compliance
Acquisition accounting for business transfer of Elessar Focchi division
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements/transactions entered by the Company during the financial year with related parties were in the ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis. The Company had entered into a related party transaction mentioned in Annexure-II in Form AOC-2. Note no. 38 to the Standalone Financial Statement sets out related party transactions as per Ind AS 24.
